selection_definitions.sample_mean: arithmetic mean of K trajectories; not a sampled trajectory; GT-free
selection_definitions.sample_medoid: real candidate minimizing summed pairwise trajectory distance; GT-free
selection_definitions.gt_endpoint_nearest_trajectory: candidate selected by the observed GT 5-second endpoint, then full trajectory scored; oracle; targets without a valid 5-second endpoint are excluded
selection_definitions.direct_minADE: minimum ADE over candidates with a valid full 5-second future; may select a different candidate
selection_definitions.direct_minFDE: minimum FDE over candidates with a valid full 5-second future; may select a different candidate
